# nanoprintf

This directory vendors the single-header nanoprintf implementation used by the
Application formatting adapter.

- Upstream: https://github.com/charlesnicholson/nanoprintf
- Version: `v0.8.0`
- Commit: `115c916031ef51b73c5c373852fa550eaf134d49`
- `nanoprintf.h` SHA-256:
  `c7e445450ce496e61f15c1cbdaa5a93e741f8ac4718f4ab6bcfedae1dc81c47c`

The upstream header and license are kept unmodified. Project-specific feature
configuration is isolated in `Dima/lib/format/Format.cpp`.
